answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 2477 Country: United Kingdom Title: Firstly i woud like to keep this question with you and me. i come from a avery strict islamic background and that i have been married for 6 years and is very happy with my husband and so is my husband happy with me, we have no children sill waiting for allah to give us inshallah , iam also in pardah since i was 13 years old, but the problem is that before marrage i wanted to get married to an egyptian qari becouse that was always been my dream becouse i also pray qiraat and speak arabic even though i am a gujarati , but when my parent said thers this boy come to see you for marrage isaw him he was gujarati i did like him and got married it was not force mariage, but now an world renownd egyptian qari came to our house ate at our house all that feelng of getting married to to the qari and the thougt of beeing with him keepsn taunting me i dnt want this to happnd ,in my heart feel realy saddnd even when i look at my husband ifeel realy guilty and sad, ilov my husband. but when i think of the qari he makes me feel realy happy and inlov with him , this sounds realy bad but i dnt even talk to any ghair mehram idnt know where this feeling is coming from and how should i stop it, i have made so much dua, i wake up every day in tahajjud just to make dua to my rabb to help me, moulana iam sorry to disturb you but ineeded someone to give me some advise, please how do i take this feeling out of my heart, moulana if i do sabr on the things which i desire in this world will allah taala give it to me in jannat inshallah, sorry moulan i know you told us to get to the point but i had to tell you other things so you can give me abetter conclusion regarding my dilemma, shukran ma aslama anisa p.s. plz moulana can you reply to me urgently i dont want my ramadhan spent in this feeling we only get ramadhan once in a year. Answer ID: 2477 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1771/1567=B) Recite لا حول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ العلی العظیم frequently. And, whenever you have such a feeling in your heart then recite اعوذ باللہ من الشیطان الرجیم and spit, in-sha-Allah such feeling will vanish away gradually. After all, pray for yourself after every obligatory salah and tahajjud with full attention. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
